description: This source file defines the MusicRepository class, which manages music data such as tracks and playlists. It provides methods to search tracks, create playlists, and add tracks to playlists, utilizing Kotlin coroutines and Flow for asynchronous data handling.

classes.name: MusicRepository
classes.description: Repository class that manages music data such as tracks and playlists, providing functionalities to search, create, and modify playlists.

methods.name: searchTracks
methods.description: Filters the list of tracks based on a search query matching title, artist, or album.

methods.name: createPlaylist
methods.description: Creates a new playlist with a specified name and user ID, adding it to the list of playlists.

methods.name: addToPlaylist
methods.description: Adds a track to an existing playlist identified by playlistId.
